headline: AB Enzymes sugar-tolerant anti-staling enzyme; NY additive ban veto fight; Callebaut 2027 trends
summary: AB Enzymes launched a sugar-tolerant enzyme for longer shelf life in sweet bakery, a direct challenge to Puratos's anti-staling and softness improvers that should be benchmarked quickly.

Industry is pressing New York Governor Hochul to veto a food additive ban; if signed, US customers selling in New York may need reformulated icings, decorations and coatings, so natural-colour alternatives should be ready.

Barry Callebaut published nine chocolate trends for 2027 and Mondelēz outlined its AI- and acquisition-led confectionery strategy, useful benchmarks for Belcolade positioning against Taste Tomorrow insights.
A new US Food Policy Accelerator is targeting ultra-processed foods, a policy thread that could reach packaged bread and cakes and favours clean-label, minimally processed solutions.
Cocoa research from Cameroon shows bean-spreading preconditioning shifts aroma and sourcing contracts improve farm practices, both relevant to origin flavour and Cacao-Trace sustainability work.

items.title: AB Enzymes targets bakery shelf life with new sugar-tolerant enzyme
items.summary: AB Enzymes has launched a sugar-tolerant enzyme aimed at extending the shelf life (anti-staling) of sweet bakery goods.
items.why: Bakery: direct competitor launch in anti-staling enzymes for high-sugar doughs (brioche, sweet buns), the core of S500/softness ranges; benchmark it and check Puratos's sugar-tolerant enzyme claims.

items.title: Barry Callebaut unveils nine chocolate trends shaping confectionery innovation in 2027 and beyond
items.summary: Barry Callebaut has published nine chocolate trends it sees shaping confectionery innovation in 2027 and beyond.
items.why: Chocolate: the leading competitor's trend agenda signals where Callebaut will push launches; compare with Taste Tomorrow insights to position Belcolade and patisserie offers.

items.title: Industry Urges Hochul to Veto NY Food Additive Ban Over $620 Cost Claim
items.summary: Industry groups are urging New York Governor Hochul to veto a food additive ban, citing a $620 cost per household claim.
items.why: Patisserie and Chocolate: if signed, New York's additive ban (likely including synthetic dyes and other additives) would force reformulation of coloured icings, decorations and coatings sold there; prepare natural-colour alternatives for US customers.

items.title: Modulation of volatile aroma compounds by bean spreading preconditioning in fermented and dried cocoa beans from the Cameroonian Amelonado “German cocoa” variety
items.summary: Study of how spreading beans before fermentation (preconditioning) changes aroma compounds in fermented, dried Cameroonian Amelonado cocoa.
items.why: Chocolate: post-harvest preconditioning is a practical lever for cocoa flavour; relevant to Belcolade origin and fermentation-driven flavour work.

items.title: Mondelēz vision for the future of confectionery and snacking
items.summary: Mondelēz outlines how it uses innovation, AI, acquisitions and brand heritage to shape confectionery and snacking.
items.why: Chocolate: Mondelēz's strategy signals demand shifts in chocolate and baked snacks among major industrial customers.

items.title: Rheology-driven and texture-driven soft sensors for differentiating animal and plant-based proteins in diverse wheat flour systems
items.summary: Purdue researchers built rheology- and texture-based soft sensors that can tell animal from plant proteins in different wheat flour systems.
items.why: Bakery: inline sensing of protein type and dough behaviour could support QC of protein-enriched or plant-based doughs; Purdue is a nearby US academic partner.

items.title: Ultrasound-assisted enzymatic and chemical modification of wheat gluten for enhanced bread and noodle quality
items.summary: Indian study combining ultrasound with enzymatic and chemical treatment to modify wheat gluten and improve bread and noodle quality.
items.why: Bakery: ultrasound-assisted enzymatic gluten modification is adjacent to Puratos's enzyme and improver work and worth tracking for weak-flour applications.
entities: Kavayitri Bahinabai Chaudhari North Maharashtra University

items.title: Effects of Market Contracts on Agroecological Implementation Intensity in Cocoa (Theobroma cacao L.) Production Systems: Evidence from Smallholder Farmers in the Mbam and Kim Division, Cameroon
items.summary: Survey of 120 Cameroonian cocoa farmers finds written market contracts are linked to more soil-health and input-reduction practices, but adoption of agroecology stays partial.
items.why: Chocolate: evidence that sourcing contracts can drive farm practice is relevant to Cacao-Trace style sustainability programmes in West/Central Africa.

items.title: Germinated Cereal Flours Exhibit Distinct Technological Properties, Water Sorption Behaviours, and Bioactive and Mineral Profiles
items.summary: Brazilian study comparing flours from germinated maize, rice and rye for technological properties, water sorption, phenolics and minerals.
items.why: Bakery: sprouted-grain flours fit clean-label and nutrition claims; the functional data (water absorption, emulsion stability) can guide sprouted-grain bread and gluten-free formulations.
entities: Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Norte

items.title: New Food Policy Accelerator focuses on UPFs
items.summary: A new Food Policy Accelerator has launched with a focus on ultra-processed foods (UPFs).
items.why: All units: UPF policy work could lead to definitions or labels that hit packaged bread, cakes and confectionery; track it and prepare clean-label, minimally processed positioning.

items.title: Natural bread trends test brands’ ability to adapt
items.summary: Podcast with Rudi's Bakery CEO Jane Miller on how the natural/organic bread brand is handling market pressures.
items.why: Bakery: insight into how US natural-bread brands are adapting, useful context for clean-label improver and sourdough sales in North America.

items.title: These Popular U.S. Bakery Brands Are Owned By A Mexican Company
items.summary: Article on popular US bakery brands owned by a Mexican company (Grupo Bimbo).
items.why: Bakery: a reminder of Grupo Bimbo's scale in US packaged bread, a key industrial customer.

items.title: Ovens and proofers offering easy operation appeal to producers
items.summary: Trade article on demand for easy-to-operate ovens and proofers among bakery producers.
items.why: Bakery: equipment simplicity trend reflects labour shortages, supporting robust improvers and easy-process solutions.

items.title: Ghirardelli brings festive twist to Peppermint Bark collection
items.summary: Ghirardelli adds baking wafers and gift packaging to its seasonal Peppermint Bark range.
items.why: Chocolate: shows US premium brands extending into baking chocolate formats, a competitive space for Belcolade in retail and foodservice.

items.title: Microbial safety and shelf‐life dynamics of sprouted wheat: technological interventions and quality management
items.summary: Review of microbial risks and shelf-life problems in sprouted wheat, and interventions to manage them.
items.why: Bakery: relevant to safely using sprouted-grain flours in bread, covering pathogen and enzyme (amylase) control.
